title: The Bag-of-Words Dilemma: Dog Bites Man
description: Demonstrating why Transformers cannot discern word order without PE.
explanation: Standard self-attention computes dot products between content embeddings. Because dot product addition is commutative and permutation invariant, the sentences 'Dog bites man' and 'Man bites dog' produce mathematically identical representations. Without positional encoding, the model cannot know who bit whom!
key_observations: Without PE, attention matrices between identical words are permutation-symmetric
Syntactic subject and direct object roles are completely erased
Positional encoding breaks symmetry by adding or rotating coordinates by word index

title: The Vaswani Clock: Multi-Frequency Harmonic Waves
description: The original 2017 Transformer architecture: Seconds, Minutes, and Hours.
explanation: Vaswani et al. (2017) designed continuous sine and cosine waves across dimensions. Low dimensions alternate rapidly like a second hand (tracking adjacent word syntax), while high dimensions oscillate slowly like an hour hand (tracking long-distance document structure). This enables the model to attend to relative positions via trigonometric angle-sum identities: cos(a - b) = cos(a)cos(b) + sin(a)sin(b).
key_observations: Dimension 0 has period 2*pi (~6.28 tokens), completing cycles rapidly
Dimension d-1 has period 2*pi*10000 (~62,831 tokens), varying smoothly
Vector addition allows linear projection layers to compute relative offsets

title: Modern Rotary Position Embeddings (RoPE)
description: How LLaMA, Mistral, and modern LLMs rotate vectors in 2D complex planes.
explanation: Rather than adding static vectors (which can corrupt semantic magnitude), RoPE (Su et al., 2021) treats each pair of vector dimensions as a 2D complex plane and multiplies them by a rotation matrix R_m. Because rotations preserve vector lengths (||R_m q|| = ||q||), the inner product between Query at pos m and Key at pos n depends strictly on the relative angle delta = (m - n) * theta.
sentence_a: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog
key_observations: RoPE preserves exact vector magnitudes (norm-preserving rotation)
Inner product <R_m q, R_n k> = q^T R_{m-n} k depends purely on relative distance
Natural recency decay: distant words rotate to near-orthogonal angles

title: LLaMA 3 Context Window Scaling: Base 10,000 vs 500,000
description: How increasing the RoPE frequency base unlocks 128k context windows.
explanation: When an LLM trained on 4k tokens encounters position 32k or 128k, high rotation frequencies wrap around the unit circle multiple times, causing catastrophic out-of-distribution confusion. Increasing the RoPE base from theta_base = 10,000 (LLaMA 1/2) to 500,000 (LLaMA 3) or 1,000,000 (LLaMA 3.1) slows angular speed, compressing 128,000 tokens into the same angular span!
sentence_a: The long document begins here and continues for 128k tokens
key_observations: Base 10,000 wraps around quickly, confusing positions > 4096
Base 500,000 slows angular speed by ~50x, accommodating 128,000 tokens
No retraining of core semantic weights required—only position frequency adjustment
